# Rust Web Framework Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > Rust

## Overview

Builds web applications and APIs with Rust using Actix Web, Axum, or Rocket with proper routing, middleware, and state management

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [rust-web-framework-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
rust-web-framework-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@rust-web-framework-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build REST APIs with Axum or Actix Web
- Implement middleware and layers for cross-cutting concerns
- Configure shared state with proper concurrency
- Design extractors for request parsing

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Axum**: Tower-based web framework patterns
- **Actix Web**: Actor-based web framework patterns
- **Tower**: Service and middleware composition
